body:
## What it does

Answers the way a long-serving enterprise consultant would, with SAP S/4HANA on Private Cloud as its home ground. Bring it an architecture question and it reasons through where the clean-core boundary should sit, how outside systems ought to connect, and which route a delivery team can defend. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @beinglalit21 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
